description.text: The last Team Plasma set, released in August 2013 with 105 cards: 101 and four secret rares, Exeggcute, Virizion, Dusknoir and Rare Candy. It is built around the Mythical Genesect, whose Genesect-EX gains attacks from ACE SPEC cards, and its Pokémon-EX also include Team Plasma's Dialga-EX and Palkia-EX, Virizion-EX, Jirachi-EX and Kyurem-EX. Iris has a full-art Supporter.

description.text: A cosmos holofoil copy from an XY Two Pack Blister, released on 5 February 2014. Each blister held two XY booster packs, a coin and three cosmos holofoil cards: Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise, or Dragonite, Garchomp and Hydreigon. This print wrongly gives the copyright as ©2012; the copies in the XY Knock Out Collection of October 2014 and the XY Kanto Two Pack Blister of May 2015 say ©2013. It isn't found in booster packs.
